questionText:

SkyHigh Airlines Ltd. spent six months and Rs. 5 Crore on external management consulting to formulate a rigid 5-year global expansion plan. However, two unforeseen external shocks struck simultaneously: global crude oil prices surged by 80% due to geopolitical warfare, and a foreign exchange currency crisis depreciated the home currency, escalating aircraft lease costs. When regional route managers noticed passenger demand collapsing on international sectors, they requested permission to re-route aircraft to lucrative domestic tier-2 routes. The executive committee refused, insisting that operational managers must adhere strictly to the approved 5-year master document ('Planning leads to rigidity'). Furthermore, lower-level managers stopped thinking creatively, waiting mechanically for head-office instructions ('Planning reduces creativity'). The airline suffered huge quarterly losses, vividly illustrating that planning cannot guarantee success in a dynamic, turbulent environment.

Which major limitation of planning was demonstrated when the executive committee prohibited route managers from modifying flight schedules in response to fuel price surges?

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
For Limitations of Planning (Nature and Significance of Management):
1. Once plans are drawn up in detail, managers may not be in a position to change them in response to changed circumstances, leading to operational rigidity.

Therefore, option (B) is the correct answer.

questionText:
Read the passage and answer the following questions:
Shilpa Rai is a 37-year-old entrepreneur who grew up in a rural district of
South Kannada. She was very good at art and craft, particularly wax molds.
She loved to make candles. Often she makes toys and small pieces of art
with wax and uses them as a gift for her friends and relatives. She is
always involved in helping poor women of the area by providing them with
jobs after imparting necessary skills. She believes that she is getting her
work done as well as helping the needy section of society. Since it is a
small business, she performs all the functions of business management
herself. But she knows that the workers are not from a sound background,
and they need motivation to perform efficiently and effectively. Slowly, the
business is growing noticeably as the number of orders is increasing. As
the orders are increasing, the production cost is declining. Based on the
knowledge and experience that Shilpa acquired in her business, she
smartly handles all the critical situations.
“Since it is a small business, she performs all the functions of business
management herself.”
Identify the functions of management performed by Shilpa in the above
case.
